# Third-party license registry

> Purpose: satisfy Apache-2.0 release and provenance-review requirements (deliverable D7).
> Every new dependency / model / dataset must be registered here with a license check.

| Asset | Type | License | Usage | Compatibility |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TBD | - | - | - | - |

Rules:
1. Only Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD-family licenses are accepted for runtime dependencies.
2. Datasets are limited to public research benchmarks (UCF101, Kinetics-400, YouTube-8M
   subsets) and synthetic data; verify each dataset's research-use terms before use.
3. ONNX model weights must be recorded with source URL, license, and hash.
